### Added
- **The muster release detects and corrects drift** (#287). The muster HelmRelease carries `spec.driftDetection.mode: enabled` (`components.muster.driftDetection`), the second release to carry it after kagent: on every reconcile — `gitops.interval` — helm-controller compares the release manifest with the cluster and re-applies what differs or is missing, as a server-side apply without a Helm revision. On a management cluster that came through the `agentic-platform` → `agent-platform` rename the live `CiliumNetworkPolicy` `muster` kept the old namespace in its egress selectors while the release manifest named the new one; Helm's three-way merge patches only what changed between two release manifests, so the object stayed drifted across every upgrade and muster's egress to Valkey stayed denied. No `ignore` rule: nothing of the platform edits this release's objects in place. An installation that sets `muster.autoscaling.enabled: true` must add one for `/spec/replicas` on the Deployment (UPGRADE.md). `tests/verify-kagent-wiring.py` asserts the set of releases that carry drift detection; the ATS smoke edits an object of the muster release and sees it reverted.
